name: hero-dot-field
title: Hero dot field
description: Dot-pattern hero background with optional streams, labels, logo mark, and pointer interaction.
usage: A Hero's `background` (`<HeroDotField fine lively streams />` on the home page, `fine lively streams miniStreams` on a short page header, `fine solidDots={false}` for a quiet field). It clears around content marked with the pattern hole attribute, or, with none marked, around the hero's text, actions and media. Color it with a text class (text-brand/60 by default, text-white/40 on blue).
avoid: A dot field behind body text
Two dot fields in one hero
Dots in a color other than the brand blue or white
notes:
The full React version of the field. `brand/dots.js` (written by the CLI) draws a lighter, still version of the stream field on any `[data-ds-dots]` hero, which the library's Hero carries; load one or the other, not both.

The grid is centered in its parent, so the leftover space splits evenly on every side. The first layout is built
before the browser paints, so the field shows with the page rather than fading in after it.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
